# YieldPocket
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/test-yield/YieldPocket.sol)

**Inherits:**
Ownable

**Title:**
YieldPocket

**Author:**
Summer

Holds excess USDC (e.g. yield) separate from user deposits in the main TestYieldToken contract.

Owner is the TestYieldToken contract. Used to isolate yield/surplus USDC from pending deposits
so amounts can be processed without mixing. Owner may withdraw to main contract for withdrawals.


## State Variables
### usdc
The USDC token held in this pocket


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable usdc
```


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _usdc, address _owner) Ownable(_owner);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_usdc`|`address`|Address of the USDC token|
|`_owner`|`address`|Owner address (typically the parent TestYieldToken)|


### withdraw

Withdraw USDC from the pocket to a recipient.


```solidity
function withdraw(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`to`|`address`|Recipient address.|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount to withdraw (6 decimals).|
